@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'FoundationModels: memory policy on MLXSpeculativeDecoding so the drafter load falls back to plain decode with a reason'
+---
+Requested by the Router session (lower priority than the MTP outcome metadata task). ChatSession's SpeculativeDecodingConfig takes a `SpeculativeDecodingMemoryPolicy` (e.g. `.recommendedWorkingSet`); `MLXSpeculativeDecoding` (MLXLanguageModel) has none, so a drafter load can overcommit.
+
+- [ ] Add an optional `memoryPolicy: SpeculativeDecodingMemoryPolicy?` (and a drafter byte estimate if needed, matching ChatSession's deferred form) to `MLXSpeculativeDecoding`, reusing the ChatSession admission code rather than copying it.
+- [ ] Not admitted: `.fallbackToDefault` decodes plain and reports `.memoryBudgetExceeded` (and the Transcript.Response metadata fallback reason); `.fail` throws `SpeculativeDecodingMemoryError`. Neither loads the drafter.
+- [ ] Forward it through the `#huggingFaceLanguageModel` macro.
+- [ ] Tests in a new file; README update.
+
+#mtp #foundation-models
\ No newline at end of file
